text:
Lina (People Ops): Mateo's Checkr flagged the driver's license scan as 'blurry / could not verify'. His start date is Mon 2025-05-12 and he needs a badge day 1.
Mateo R: Ugh, sorry - I scanned it with my phone in low light. I can retake tonight. Is JPG okay?
Lina (People Ops): JPG or PNG is fine, but keep each side as a separate file and <10MB. If upload fails we can do courier pickup for originals.
Mateo R: I can be around 9-11am Mon for pickup if needed.
Evan - Facilities: Courier window 9:00-11:30. We require an authorization note signed by the candidate. If Mateo can e-sign (typed name) that's acceptable.
Lina (People Ops): Copy-paste release text for Mateo to sign:
```
I authorize Redwood Inference to release original ID documents to courier for verification at 890 Folsom St Apt 2 on 2025-05-12.
Name: Mateo Rivera
Email: mateo.r@example.com
Signature (type full name): Mateo Rivera
Date: 2025-05-11
```
Mateo R: Signed (typed): Mateo Rivera. Also re-uploaded two PNGs just now.
Checkr Vendor Bot: Document received, running automated checks (ocr + image quality). Status: processing.
Onboard Bot: Reminder: Badge pickup and orientation Mon 2025-05-12 2:30pm lobby. Bring original government ID.
Lina (People Ops): Evan, please hold a spare temporary badge in case Checkr finalizes late. If courier is needed we'll coordinate.
Evan - Facilities: Will do. Also note: if identity verification delayed past 3pm we can issue a 24-hour temp badge with escort.
Mateo R: Thanks team. Quick benefits question: is the benefits enrollment deadline 30 days from start?
Lina (People Ops): Yes, benefits window is 30 days. I'll DM you the enrollment portal link and schedule for benefits 101.
Mateo R: Perfect, appreciate it :smile:
Lina (People Ops): Closing loop for now - I'll update the Checkr notes with the signed release and re-uploaded images. Will re-open thread if courier is required. :white_check_mark:
